---
title: "Supported risk of bias tools"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", fig.width = 9, fig.height = 4, dpi = 150)
```

| `rob_tool` | Tool | Domain columns | Overall columns | Judgements |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `"rob2"` | RoB 2 (incl. cluster and crossover variants) | D1, (D1b), D2–D5, (DS) | Overall | Low, Some concerns, High |
| `"robins_i"` | ROBINS-I V2 (2025) | D1–D6 | Overall | Low, Low (except confounding), Moderate, Serious, Critical |
| `"robins_e"` | ROBINS-E (2024) | D1–D7 | Overall | Low, Low (except confounding), Some concerns, High, Very high |
| `"quadas2"` | QUADAS-2 | D1–D4 | Overall | Low, Unclear, High |
| `"clarity"` | CLARITY | D1–D10, (D11), (D12) | None | Definitely/Probably low, Probably/Definitely high |
| `"rob_nma"` | RoB NMA (+ ROBIS 1–3) | (R1–R3), D1–D3 | Results, Conclusions | Low, Some concerns, High |
| `"probast"` | PROBAST (2019) | D1–D4, (A1–A3) | Overall, Applicability | Low, Unclear, High |
| `"probast_ai"` | PROBAST+AI (2025) | D1–D4, (A1–A3) | Overall, Applicability | Low, Unclear, High |

Columns in brackets are optional. `NA` is shown as "Not applicable".

## RoB NMA

```{r}
library(robbR)

nma_data <- tibble::tibble(
  Author = c("Review A", "Review B"),
  Year = c(2023, 2024),
  R1 = c("Low", "Unclear"),
  R2 = c("Low", "Low"),
  R3 = c("High", "Low"),
  D1 = c("Low", "Some concerns"),
  D2 = c("Some concerns", "Low"),
  D3 = c("High", "Low"),
  Conclusions = c("Concerns", "No concerns"))

rob_plot(nma_data, rob_tool = "rob_nma", add_rob_legend = TRUE)
```

## PROBAST+AI

```{r}
probast_data <- tibble::tibble(
  Author = c("Garcia", "Kim", "Garcia", "Okafor"),
  Year = c(2022, 2023, 2022, 2024),
  Subgroup = c("Development", "Development", "Evaluation", "Evaluation"),
  D1 = c("Low", "High", "Low", "Unclear"),
  D2 = c("Low", "Low", "Low", "Low"),
  D3 = c("Unclear", "Low", "Low", "Low"),
  D4 = c("High", "High", "Low", "Unclear"),
  A1 = c("Low", "Low", "High", "Low"),
  A2 = c("Low", "Unclear", "Low", "Low"),
  A3 = c("Low", "Low", "Low", "Low"))

rob_plot(probast_data, rob_tool = "probast_ai", subgroup = TRUE, sort_subgroup_by = c("Development", "Evaluation"))
```
